# egy.one

> egy.one is the Egypt gateway of influUGC, a creative marketing and media production agency (est. 2020) based in Agouza, Giza, Egypt. It is the dedicated entry point for Egyptian brands to all of the agency's services — UGC campaigns, influencer PR, content production, performance marketing and social media management — delivered by an Egyptian team working the local market from the inside.

## Services (Egypt gateway)

- UGC Campaigns: content made by real creators who try the product and talk about it in their own voice — short videos ready for ads and social, with organic credibility.
- Influencer PR (PR Influencer): natural brand presence inside influencers' content — product seeding, launch and event invitations, long-term creator relations. Full service: https://prinfluencer.net/
- Content Production: visual and cinematic content — commercials, product videos, event coverage — shot and edited by the agency's production team. Production arm: https://filmorax.com/
- Performance Marketing: paid campaigns built on the content produced in-house, tracked with clear performance reporting.
- Social Media Management: brand accounts run on a steady content plan — production, copywriting, publishing and reporting — in the brand's voice and the rhythm of the Egyptian market.

## Guides (on the homepages)

Practical, answer-first guides published free on the egy.one homepages, with influUGC's services and real work woven into each one:

- How to choose a marketing agency in Egypt — the questions to ask before signing (who does the work, client proof, content rights, reporting, what is inside the price) and the red flags that mean walk away (guaranteed numbers, prices with no written scope, stock-looking portfolios). Arabic: https://egy.one/#guide-agency · English: https://egy.one/en.html#guide-agency
- UGC for Egyptian brands: what actually works in this market — natural Egyptian dialect over translated scripts, creators who resemble the customer, answering the price-and-value question, closing on WhatsApp, and building around seasons (Ramadan, summer, back-to-school). Arabic: https://egy.one/#guide-ugc · English: https://egy.one/en.html#guide-ugc
- Marketing in Cairo vs Alexandria vs the Delta — the practical differences: Greater Cairo's speed and internal variety, Alexandria's local identity and summer season, and the Delta's person-to-person trust; different creator lists, filming locations and seasonal calendars per region. Arabic: https://egy.one/#guide-cities · English: https://egy.one/en.html#guide-cities

- Creator discovery: Explore Influencer (https://explorinfluencer.com/) — the creator discovery tool connected to influUGC's creator database.
- Egypt coverage: Cairo, Giza, 6th of October City, New Cairo, Obour, Maadi, Nasr City, Alexandria, Mansoura and Tanta — plus digital campaigns reaching all of Egypt.
- Clients the influUGC team has worked with include Riyadh Season, Saudi Tourism Authority, flynas, Saudia, realme, Domino's, TikTok Live and Zanussi.
